preconditions.description: The size of the chessboard is between 1 and 1000.
The initial position of the Knight is within the bounds of the chessboard.
The target position of the Knight is within the bounds of the chessboard.

postconditions.description: The function returns either the minimum number of steps required or -1 if it's not possible to reach the target.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(abs(KnightPos[0] - TargetPos[0]) + abs(KnightPos[1] - TargetPos[1]) <= 3) else True
postconditions.description: If the initial and target positions are too close, return -1 as it's not possible for the Knight to move.
